series_key: how to create a simple multi-currency expert advisor using mql5
mechanism: Set_Time_Zone computes server−GMT hour offset from TimeTradeServer vs TimeGMT, then maps NZ (+12), Sydney (+10), Tokyo (+9), London (0), NY (−5) local open/close hours into server-time SesXXOp/SesXXCl windows; Trade_session() returns true only while TimeCurrent is inside the selected window (custom start/stop also supported). Outside session, opens are gated while trailing/weak-signal closes may continue.
data_needed: TimeTradeServer(); TimeGMT(); session enum; optional custom hour/minute; day-of-week flags
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: 30 FX pairs + XAUUSD/XAGUSD; PSAR on M5/M30/H1/H4; session filter independent of chart TF
why_new_for_mis: Broker-offset-aware major-session membership is a reusable liquidity/activity regime label MIS can emit per clock without hard-coding one broker TZ.
quote: To get the trading time zone, we must first know the latest time from the current time of the trade server. Then we also have to know the time difference (in hours) from the time of trader server compared to GMT/UTC time.

series_key: how to create a simple multi-currency expert advisor using mql5
mechanism: GetPSARSignalMTF loops TFArrays (M5,M30,H1,H4): PARSARMTF copies iSAR buffer 0 and scores rise if PSAR[0]<Low0 and Close>Open, down if PSAR[0]>High0 and Close<Open; buy/sell only if every TF votes the same way. GetOpenPosition further requires DirectionMove agreement.
data_needed: iSAR handles per symbol×TF; OHLC via iOpen/iHigh/iLow/iClose; TFArrays=4
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD..CHFJPY + XAUUSD/XAGUSD; M5/M30/H1/H4 consensus; also M5 SAR handles
why_new_for_mis: Hard unanimous multi-TF SAR+candle-direction vote is a crisp multi-scale directional regime sensor MIS can threshold or soften into a vote share.

series_key: how to create a simple multi-currency expert advisor using mql5
mechanism: TradingToday() reads day_of_week from TimeCurrent into ttd[0..6] Yes/No inputs (default Sun/Sat No, Mon–Fri Yes) and blocks ExpertActionTrade opens when the current weekday is disabled; session and day gates AND together.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same 30-pair multi-currency book; calendar independent of TF
why_new_for_mis: Explicit per-weekday activity mask is a simple calendar regime channel MIS can combine with session sensors.

series_key: how to create a simple multi-currency expert advisor using mql5
mechanism: Triangular MA (Mladen) buffer 1 is INDICATOR_COLOR_INDEX: valc uses slope of val—2=MediumSeaGreen buy, 1=DeepPink sell, 0=DarkGray unknown. EA CopyBuffer(...,1,...) treats color as the primary directional state rather than the MA level alone.
data_needed: iCustom Triangular MA handle; buffer 1 color index; period/applied price inputs
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: 30 FX+metals; MTF start/end from M5–D1 (e.g. M15–H4); STF selectable M5–D1; default period 14 PRICE_CLOSE
why_new_for_mis: Color-index slope state as the traded signal is a discrete regime label MIS can ingest without re-deriving MA slope logic.
quote: You can use the color change as signal... 0-DarkGray = Unknown signal; 1-DeepPink = Sell Signal; 2-MediumSeaGreen = Buy Signal.

series_key: how to create a simple multi-currency expert advisor using mql5
mechanism: In MTF mode GetTriaMASignalMTF counts TriaMASMTF over TFTri[start..end]; each TF contributes rise if TriMACI[0]==2.0 else down if ==1.0; open only if trimup==tfloop or trimdw==tfloop. GetOpenPosition also requires GetSignalMidTF (mid TF color + DirectionMove) agreement.
data_needed: hTriMAb[symbol][tf] handles; tfstart/tfclose; DirectionMove on TFCWS
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: 30 pairs+XAU/XAG; selectable contiguous TF band M5–D1; mid-TF for confirm/weak-exit
why_new_for_mis: Unanimous TriMA color across a trader-chosen TF band is a multi-scale trend-agreement sensor MIS can expose as vote fraction.
quote: Buy signal, if on all selected timeframes the indicator is colored MediumSeaGreen, and Sell signal, if on all selected timeframes the indicator is DeepPink colored.

series_key: how to create a simple multi-currency expert advisor using mql5
mechanism: In STF mode TriaMASMTF requires a 3-bar color sequence: buy if TriMACI[2]==1 && [1]==2 && [0]==2 (pink→green→green); sell if [2]==2 && [1]==1 && [0]==1 (green→pink→pink)—explicit regime-change confirmation rather than level cross.
data_needed: 3 bars of TriMA color buffer on single selected TF
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same 30-pair book; single TF from M5–D1 (default H1)
why_new_for_mis: Encoded opposite→new→hold color flip is a lightweight change detector MIS can reuse on any colorized MA/oscillator.
quote: Buy signal, if the previous 2 bars are DeepPink, and the previous 1 bar is MediumSeaGreen and the current bar is MediumSeaGreen.

series_key: how to create a simple multi-currency expert advisor using mql5
mechanism: GetCloseInWeakSignal / GetSignalMidTF read TriMA color on TFCWS (auto mid of MTF band or STF−2); if open buy is profitable and mid color flips to sell (with DirectionMove), close to save profit—and symmetrically for sells. SaveOnRev gates the behavior.
data_needed: hTriMAm mid-TF handle; position profit; DirectionMove
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: 30 pairs; TFCWS derived from MTF/STF selection
why_new_for_mis: Mid-horizon color weakening as an exit sensor separates entry consensus from hold-strength sensing for MIS.
quote: Close Trade and Save profit due to weak signal

series_key: how to create a simple multi-currency expert advisor using mql5
mechanism: Keltner Channel custom indicator (EMA period 20 + ATR period 20 × multiplier) supplies handle hKC; iBands(symbol,TFt,BBPeriod=38,0,BBDevi,hKC) applies Bollinger to the KC series (MQL5 replacement for MT4 iBandsOnArray). Nested ATR envelope + stdev bands sense volatility structure on the channel, not raw price alone.
data_needed: iCustom Keltner handle; iBands applied to hKC; KCPeriod/ATR/BBPeriod/deviation inputs
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: 30 FX+metals; selectable TF M5–D1 (default H1); iSAR trailing on same TF + M5
why_new_for_mis: Bands-on-channel nesting is a volatility-of-envelope sensor pattern MIS can generalize beyond price Bollinger.
quote: by using the iBands() indicator handle, we can actually easily create iBandOnArray() in MQL5... the Bollinger Bands indicator will use price data from the Keltner Channel indicator.

series_key: how to create a simple multi-currency expert advisor using mql5
mechanism: BBOnKeltnerChannel copies KC mid/upper/lower and BB base/upper/lower (3 bars). Buy if KC mid crosses up BB lower OR mid OR upper by >1.5 pips; sell if KC mid crosses down BB upper OR mid OR lower by >1.5 pips—three nested threshold change events on one mid line.
data_needed: CopyBuffer hKC 0/1/2 and hBB 0/1/2; pip size; difud=1.5*pip
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: 30 pairs+XAU/XAG; signal TF from TFUSE (default H1)
why_new_for_mis: Multi-threshold mid-vs-band crosses give MIS graded breakout/mean-reversion change events from one nested channel stack.
quote: First signal: When the middle line of the Keltner Channel indicator crosses up the lower line of the Bollinger Bands® indicator; or Second signal: ... middle line ...; or Third signal: ... upper line ...

series_key: how to create a simple multi-currency expert advisor using mql5
mechanism: GetCloseInWeakSignal: close profitable buys when KC lower crosses down BB upper (KClb[1]>=BBub[1] && KClb[0]<BBub[0]-difud) with DirectionMove down; close profitable sells when KC upper crosses up BB lower—band-to-band exhaustion rather than mid-line entry logic.
data_needed: KC upper/lower and BB upper/lower buffers; DirectionMove; SaveOnRev flag
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same 30-pair book and selected signal TF
why_new_for_mis: Opposite-band KC↔BB cross as weakness exit is a distinct change sensor MIS can pair with the triple-threshold entry events.
quote: For close the Buy orders: When the lower line of the Keltner Channel indicator crosses down the upper line of Bollinger Bands®, the Buy order will be closed.
